us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump pledges $5,000 payments if Republicans keep Congress
bullets: Trump made the pledge at the GOP midterm convention in Dallas.
AP described the promise as extraordinary and fiscally dubious.
The proposal was tied to Republicans retaining House and Senate control.

articles.title: Republicans campaign on Trump’s sweeping tax-and-spending law
bullets: GOP candidates highlighted the law at the Dallas midterm convention.
The package includes tax breaks, social-service cuts and immigration enforcement.
AP reported its effects have been mixed for voters so far.

articles.title: Amazon cargo-plane pilot warned Miami landing was too fast
bullets: NTSB information showed one pilot repeatedly warned about speed.
The plane overran a Miami runway and struck a van, killing five people.
Investigators are reviewing cockpit recordings and flight data.

articles.title: Fetterman speaks at GOP convention, intensifying party-switch worries
bullets: Sen. John Fetterman appeared at the Republican midterm convention.
He said he would work with Trump to defend the steel industry.
The appearance deepened concerns among some Democrats about his party alignment.

articles.title: US jobless claims dip to 206,000
bullets: Weekly unemployment claims fell slightly, AP reported.
Layoffs remain historically rare by recent standards.
Employers have averaged 80,000 added jobs per month so far this year.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Philippines ferry fire leaves at least 5 dead and dozens missing
bullets: The M/V June Aster caught fire off Palawan while bound for Coron.
Authorities reported at least five deaths and more than 80 people missing.
Rescue teams continued searching as the cause remained under investigation.

articles.title: China port cargo-ship fire kills 25, state media says
bullets: A cargo ship caught fire while docked for repairs in eastern China.
State media reported 25 people dead after the blaze.
Chinese leaders ordered urgent rescue and response efforts.

articles.title: Japan sends helicopters to fight Indonesia wildfires
bullets: A Japanese military transport ship arrived in Borneo on Thursday.
The mission brought CH-47 helicopters for firefighting operations.
Indonesia’s wildfire haze has affected health across parts of the region.

articles.title: Zelenskyy visits Canada seeking more military aid
bullets: Ukraine’s president traveled to Canada for support talks.
Kyiv is seeking continued weapons supplies from partners.
Canada and European countries are also buying US weapons for Ukraine under PURL.

articles.title: China landslide death toll rises to 16
bullets: Authorities reported additional deaths in southeastern China landslides.
AP said victims were found in multiple towns.
Search and recovery efforts continued after the disaster.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Xi’s India visit signals diplomatic thaw, but business doubts remain
bullets: Reuters reported Xi Jinping’s expected New Delhi visit would be his first to India in seven years.
The trip is expected to support a China-India diplomatic thaw.
Business ties remain constrained by security and trust concerns.

articles.title: India food regulator tells Supreme Court it is open to stricter labelling
bullets: FSSAI said it was open to tougher food-labelling rules.
The issue is before India’s Supreme Court.
Reuters reported the move amid scrutiny of packaged-food disclosures.

articles.title: Centre offers Article 371(K) framework for Ladakh
bullets: The Centre proposed a new constitutional safeguard for Ladakh.
Indian Express reported key powers remain undecided.
The offer followed talks with Ladakh representatives and the Home Ministry.

articles.title: Delhi civic body demolishes 58 buildings after Satya Niketan collapse
bullets: MCD demolished 58 structures after the deadly Satya Niketan collapse.
Orders were issued for 31 more demolitions.
The action followed concerns over unsafe and unauthorised construction.

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Abu Salem’s early-release plea
bullets: The court dismissed Abu Salem’s plea for premature release.
Salem is serving a life term in the 1993 Mumbai blasts case.
The court upheld the view that his request was premature.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Notable US market movers from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Meta jumps after launching Muse AI agent
bullets: Meta shares rose more than 6% on Wednesday.
The gain followed the launch of its personal AI agent, Muse.
The move helped limit broader S&P 500 losses.

articles.title: Apple slips as iPhone Duo debuts
bullets: Apple shares dipped after the foldable iPhone launch.
The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, Reuters reported.
The launch came as oil and Treasury yields weighed on equities.

articles.title: Amazon falls as retailers lead market lower
bullets: Amazon shares fell 2.1% during Wednesday trading.
Retailers were among the biggest weights on the market.
The broader selloff came as oil climbed above $100 a barrel.

articles.title: Novartis ADRs tumble after therapy-study update
bullets: US-traded Novartis shares fell 13.9% on Tuesday.
The drop followed a discouraging update on a myotonic dystrophy therapy study.
The move came during a broader oil-driven stock pullback.

articles.title: Boston Scientific slides after cyber incident hits outlook
bullets: Boston Scientific fell 5.9% on Tuesday.
The company said a network outage from a cybersecurity incident hurt expectations.
It warned it was unlikely to meet third-quarter and full-year forecasts.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Major corporate and economic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Amazon raises £4.25 billion in debut sterling bond sale
bullets: Amazon raised about $5.76 billion in its first sterling bond sale.
Reuters said demand exceeded the initial size of the deal.
The proceeds are tied to funding needs for AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Deloitte expects faster US holiday retail sales growth
bullets: Deloitte forecast holiday sales growth of 4% to 4.8%.
The estimate covers November 2026 through January 2027.
Reuters said value-focused consumers remain a key theme for retailers.

articles.title: Qualcomm and Amazon partner on AI data-center infrastructure
bullets: Qualcomm announced a multi-generational collaboration with Amazon.
The partnership focuses on AI chips and next-generation data-center infrastructure.
The deal includes work on optical networking and AI systems.

articles.title: Cognition AI raises $2 billion at $48 billion valuation
bullets: The AI coding startup closed a $2 billion Series E round.
Reuters said the valuation nearly doubled from May.
Cognition develops autonomous software-engineering agents, including Devin.

articles.title: Trump threatens Bombardier despite jetmaker’s US footprint
bullets: Trump targeted Canadian private-jet maker Bombardier amid trade tensions.
Bombardier said major aircraft components are produced in the US.
AP reported the company relies heavily on US suppliers.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone
bullets: The iPhone Duo has a 7.6-inch inner display and 5.4-inch outer display.
Apple said preorders begin October 16, with availability October 23.
The device starts at $1,999 in the US.

articles.title: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent
bullets: Muse is designed to help with tasks such as email, shopping and travel.
Meta announced the product on Tuesday.
The launch is part of Meta’s broader push into consumer AI agents.

articles.title: OpenAI backs mandatory national AI safety rules
bullets: OpenAI called for federal AI safety requirements.
The company also backed several California AI-related bills.
The statement followed scrutiny of autonomous AI-agent behavior.

articles.title: Google to invest $15.1 billion in AI infrastructure in Finland
bullets: Google announced at least €13 billion in Finland investment.
Reuters called it Google’s largest single investment in Europe.
The spending targets data centers and digital infrastructure over two years.

articles.title: Meta acquires Swedish AI startup Stilla.ai
bullets: Axios reported Meta acquired Stilla.ai.
The deal is aimed at accelerating Meta Business Agent development.
The technology supports transactions across WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.
